about: The area of life or work the dossier helps with. These follow the onRails packs. A dossier has one to three, and the first is its main home.

values.label: Core method
values.means: How to work with AI agents on any job: planning, questions, review, memory, safety and the research method itself.

values.label: Apps
values.means: Building software: web, mobile and desktop apps, their code, tests, hosting and launch checks.

values.label: Research
values.means: Doing research well: finding sources, checking facts, keeping data, and running a commons like this one.

values.label: Data
values.means: Working with data: SQL, pipelines, dashboards, reports, file formats and data quality.

values.label: Infrastructure
values.means: Servers, home labs, DNS, cloud setup, containers and the cost of running them.

values.label: Personal security
values.means: Protecting a person: accounts, passwords, two-factor, privacy settings and getting your data removed.

values.label: Online presence
values.means: How a person or brand shows up online: profiles, social media, a personal site and its links.

values.label: Content
values.means: Writing and publishing: a blog, a newsletter, a talk, and checking facts and reading level.

values.label: Business
values.means: Running a small business: admin, clients, invoices, contracts, licences and deadlines.

values.label: Launch
values.means: After the first version: going public, search, the marketing site, analytics and first users.

values.label: Career
values.means: Finding work: a resume, a portfolio, applications and interview prep.

values.label: Learning
values.means: Learning a skill: study plans, exercises and how to tell that you got better.

values.label: Money
values.means: Personal money: budgets, debt, savings and getting taxes in order.

values.label: Life admin
values.means: Life tasks with forms and deadlines: a move, a vehicle, an event, a home project.
